'''The Sandstorm''', also known as the '''Sandstorm Club''', was an exclusive club within-a-club at [[Bantha Traxx]] on [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. The entire third floor of Bantha Traxx was reserved for VIP guests such as the elite of Lianna society.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
